items.title: Classify material code diffs and required review assurance before DONE
items.context: Implement the documented review-assurance floor: material code diffs require at least one current-material review round; docs/typo/annotation-only work may remain lower-risk. Use structured state and existing Lattice evidence, not prose-only claims.

happy.desc: A material code diff story with one valid current-material local review round satisfies the review assurance floor without requiring 3x2 by default

edge.desc: A docs-only markdown diff is not classified as material code and is not overblocked by the zero-review code floor

adversarial.desc: A material code diff story with zero current-material review evidence is blocked before DONE with an actionable review assurance floor message

items.userSees: DONE Gate Checklist shows Review assurance floor: PASS for material code diff after one fresh local review round; zero-review material code shows a blocking missing_review_floor reason.

verificationEvidence.note: review-assurance-floor smoke passed: one fresh local review round passes clean material code without requiring 3x2.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: docs-only markdown is not overblocked.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: zero-review material code is blocked with formatted DONE diagnostic.

items.title: Escalate failure-triggered code-change stories to three local single-host rounds
items.context: If validation fail, bug, verified reviewer finding, post-DONE regression, or repeated rework is present for a material code diff, DONE must require 3 rounds x 1 local host unless a stronger high-risk policy applies.

happy.desc: A validation failure, bug, or verified finding signal makes a material code story require three local single-host rounds before DONE

edge.desc: A failure-triggered story remains escalated after repair until the required fresh-material rounds exist

adversarial.desc: Stale or missing materialDigest host verdicts do not satisfy the failure-triggered 3x1 requirement

items.userSees: review_escalation_status reports required=true and degradedFallback 3/3 rounds x 1 host only after failure-triggered material code stories have fresh bound local review verdicts.

verificationEvidence.note: review-assurance-floor smoke passed: bug and verified-reviewer-finding failure signals require three local rounds.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: fixed bug evidence remains a sticky failure signal until 3x1 local rounds exist.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: stale materialDigest host verdicts do not count.

items.title: Preserve host-neutral Authority boundary in review assurance evidence
items.context: Local review assurance evidence is Non-authority and must not set authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, or imply Authority Server receipt-backed completion.

happy.desc: Local review assurance reports authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, and productionDone=false for both one-round and 3x1 evidence

edge.desc: Degraded single-host evidence is labeled degraded-single-host and never as two-host independent review

adversarial.desc: A forged local process event that claims Authority completion does not become Authority Server receipt-backed proof

items.userSees: Local review assurance output explicitly prints authorityDone: false, fullAuthorityDone: false, productionDone: false, and never calls local host verdicts Authority Server receipts.

verificationEvidence.note: review-assurance-floor smoke passed: one-round and 3x1 reports keep authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone false.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: failure-triggered 3x1 success is labeled degraded-single-host, not full 3x2.
review-assurance-floor smoke passed: forged local authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone fields remain false in the evaluator report.
process-fact contract verified the L4 review assurance floor fact and no-overclaim boundary tokens.

items.title: Expose actionable DONE preflight diagnostics and tests
items.context: Add tests and CLI diagnostics proving zero-review code DONE blocks, clean code one-round passes, failure signal requires 3x1, high-risk remains 3x2/degraded, and docs-only low-risk is not overblocked.

happy.desc: The smoke task covers zero-review block, one-round pass, failure-triggered 3x1 pass, and Authority flags false

edge.desc: DONE preflight diagnostics name the missing assurance reason and next action

adversarial.desc: Process-fact contract fails if the new DONE gate semantics are documented only in prose and not registered as gate-consumed facts

items.userSees: Running the review-assurance-floor smoke command prints PASS for zero-review block, one-round pass, failure-triggered 3x1, stale verdict rejection, docs-only non-overblock, and Authority flags false.
